description_en: Lists the skills visible to the current tenant
description_zh: 列出当前租户可见的技能
name: ListSkills

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. If not specified, the default tenant of the caller is used
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数，缺省时使用调用方默认租户
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en:
The filter expression type.

SQL: SQL-based filtering.
TAG: Tag-based filtering
parameters.help_zh:
过滤表达式类型。

SQL：SQL过滤
TAG：Tag过滤
parameters.name: filter_type

parameters.help_en: The search keyword. Supports fuzzy search by API name or exact search by API ID
parameters.help_zh: 搜索关键词，支持API名称模糊搜索或API ID精确搜索
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The digital employee name. Used to calculate the CodeAgent allowedSkills whitelist based on binding relationships
parameters.help_zh: 数字员工名称；用于按绑定关系计算CodeAgent allowedSkills 白名单
parameters.name: operating_object_name

parameters.help_en: The binding status. Valid values: BOUND (bound) and UNBOUND (unbound global skills). Must be specified together with operatingObjectName
parameters.help_zh: 绑定状态：BOUND(已绑定) / UNBOUND(未绑定的全局技能)；必须与 operatingObjectName 同时传入
parameters.name: bind_status
